title: Thursday Teacher Plan
note: Short week: Mon, Thu, Fri only. Blooket reviews Monday. One turn-in each: the exit ticket. Tomorrow: 8th DONUTS vote; 6th/7th dumbbell break test (your observation is 6th Period).

4th Period.topic: Juice Week, Day 2: build the juice with Copilot
4th Period.goal: By the end of class, my live game shows my juice every time the ball hits my paddle, and the rules still play the same.
4th Period.exitTicket: What juice did you add, and does it show every time the ball hits your paddle?
prep: Day 2 handout attached to Juice Week on Google Classroom; exit ticket posted
Your own Codespace open to model the prompt

segments.title: Blooket quiz
segments.do: Students play the 10-question Blooket reviewing Monday.
tips: Watch the live results for the most-missed question.

segments.title: Review quiz answers + today's goal
segments.do: Re-teach the most-missed question, then read the goal: By the end of class, my live game shows my juice every time the ball hits my paddle, and the rules still play the same.
tips: Likely most-missed: which change is NOT juice (the ball speeding up changes the rules)
Point to the goal again halfway through and at the exit ticket.

segments.title: I do: plan, prompt, check
segments.do: Model it live: read the worked plan, type the prompt frame into Copilot Chat, keep the changes, hit the ball 5 times, check speed is unchanged.
segments.why: Gradual release: one full worked round before they try.
tips: Say the rule out loud: only change how it looks.
Show where Keep/Accept is.

segments.title: You do: Copilot builds their juice
segments.do: Students paste their Monday plan into the frame, keep, test, and re-prompt with exactly what they see.
segments.why: Students design; Copilot writes code. The skill assessed is design and checking.
tips: Most common: juice stays on forever, so prompt 'go away after 15 frames'.
Ball got faster? 'Undo the speed change.'
Assign competence: praise a student whose re-prompt was precise.

segments.title: Commit, Sync Changes, hard refresh, play
segments.do: Commit with a message, Sync Changes, wait a minute, Ctrl + Shift + R on the live Pages game.
segments.why: The live game is what gets judged tomorrow.
tips: Drop-off point is this chain: walk the room and check that Sync Changes was actually clicked.

segments.title: Exit ticket
segments.do: Typed on Google Classroom with frames.
tips: Full answer: two named effects + every time + rules stayed the same.

watchFor: Students who never committed: the preview works but the live game doesn't.
Copilot rewriting many files: ask what it changed.

6th Period.goal: By the end of class, my group's cardboard fix is on our Test 1 X, every joint passes the tug test, and our bridge is drying for Friday's break test.
6th Period.exitTicket: Where did your group add cardboard, and why there?
prep: Bridges back to table groups; cardboard scraps, glue sticks, scissors
A drying spot that won't be disturbed overnight

segments.title: Blooket quiz
segments.do: Students play the 10-question Blooket reviewing Monday.
tips: Watch the live results for the most-missed question.

segments.title: Review quiz answers + today's goal
segments.do: Re-teach the most-missed question, then read the goal: By the end of class, my group's cardboard fix is on our Test 1 X, every joint passes the tug test, and our bridge is drying for Friday's break test.
tips: Likely most-missed: which chord is squeezed (top = compression)
Point to the goal again halfway through and at the exit ticket.

segments.title: Roles by birthday
segments.do: Inspector, Cutter, Gluer, Checker. 3: Checker cuts too. 5: two Cutters.
tips: The Checker approves every piece before glue.

segments.title: Read your X
segments.do: Inspectors name the failure: joint popped, strip bent, deck sagged, or leaned. Tie it to Monday: squeezed parts buckle, stretched parts tear, joints pop.
tips: Cold call an Inspector after think time: what failed, and was it squeezed or stretched?

segments.title: You do: up to 6 fix pieces
segments.do: Repair, dot the fix spots, Checker approves, cut (length + glue square each end), glue face to face.
segments.why: Targeted fix = iteration based on test data.
tips: Halfway: revisit the goal.
Edge-glued pieces fall off; push gussets and doubling.

segments.title: Tug test
segments.do: Checker tugs every joint they touched.

segments.title: Exit ticket
segments.do: Where they added cardboard and why there.
tips: Full answer: the spot + the Test 1 failure + tension or compression.

segments.title: Clean up + set to dry
segments.do: Bridges to the drying spot, names on a label.

watchFor: Tomorrow's observation: note which groups are confident so you can call on them in the class data talk.

7th Period.topic: Final upgrade: 4 sticks where it will break
7th Period.goal: By the end of class, my group has added up to 4 more popsicle sticks where we predicted the break, and our bridge is drying for Friday's break test.
7th Period.exitTicket: Where did your popsicle sticks go, and why there?
prep: 4 popsicle sticks per group counted out (the Checker collects them), paper, glue sticks, scissors

segments.title: Blooket quiz
segments.do: Students play the 10-question Blooket reviewing Monday.
tips: Watch the live results for the most-missed question.

segments.title: Review quiz answers + today's goal
segments.do: Re-teach the most-missed question, then read the goal: By the end of class, my group has added up to 4 more popsicle sticks where we predicted the break, and our bridge is drying for Friday's break test.
tips: Likely most-missed: which chord is squeezed (top = compression)
Point to the goal again halfway through and at the exit ticket.

segments.title: Roles by birthday
segments.do: Predictor, Stick Gluer, Wrapper, Checker. 3: Checker wraps too. 5: two Stick Gluers.

segments.title: Squeezed or stretched? Pick your spots
segments.do: Predictor reads Monday's prediction and points; group decides squeezed, stretched, or joint.
segments.why: Apply Monday's reading to their own design.
tips: Ask: why does a stick glued flat stop buckling? (stiffer, can't bend sideways)

segments.title: You do: up to 4 sticks, flat + wrapped
segments.do: Flat sticks on squeezed or stretched parts; paper wraps on joints.
segments.why: Engineering trade-off: limited material, placed with a reason.
tips: Paper wraps use Monday's fact: paper is strong in tension.
Stop anyone loading the bridge today.

segments.title: Tug test
segments.do: Checker tugs every upgraded joint.

segments.title: Exit ticket
segments.do: Where the sticks went and why.
tips: Full answer: spot + squeezed/stretched + buckle/tear/pop.

segments.title: Clean up + set to dry
segments.do: Bridges to the drying spot with names.

watchFor: Groups that want challenge: Future Engineer strength-per-stick math.

accommodations: Agenda on the board, goal reviewed after the Blooket and mid-lesson, numbered steps, worked example or diagram first, checklists, sentence frames, frequent check-ins.
Squeezed/stretched shown with the paper strip and diagram, partner talk before writing, two sentence frames.
Lexend Deca handouts, steps read aloud, speech-to-text OK, spelling not graded.
Hands-on roles (Cutter, Gluer, Wrapper), short timed chunks with a visual timer, discreet redirection, break pass.
Extended time; floor version: 8th one juice effect, 7th one fix piece on the X, 6th one stick on the predicted spot; dictated exit tickets; intentional groups.
frameworks: 8th polishes toward tomorrow's DONUTS vote; 6th/7th prepare the bridge they'll break publicly tomorrow.
Birthday-order roles; Checkers hold approval authority; assign competence publicly.
Predictable routine, one turn-in, 'you are not behind'.
Apply/Create today, between Monday's Understand and Friday's Evaluate.
